label: Strict primacy: everything other than the primary approaches it less nearly…, from reception limits
description: Derives strict primacy (nothing other than the primary approaches it as nearly as it stands) from the q.7 reception account: another thing is a creature, so its esse is received (OPEN generalization of q.7 a.2), so limited (STMT-RECEIVED-ESSE-IS-LIMITED); the primary's esse is received in nothing (OPEN reading of q.7 a.1), so by the stated q.7 a.1 warrant that limited esse is received it is not limited; and limited esse approaches less nearly than unlimited (OPEN bridge). Degrees of approach lie in a parameter preorder.
